entries.notes: PRs 31, 32, 33, 35, and 39 independently proposed fixes for the same required-tool guard (PRs 35 and 39 added after the entry was first seeded). PR 31 is the prospective canonical executable lineage because it also carries two additional independently verified fixes.

entries.trigger: HOME/Desktop directory missing under set -euo pipefail
entries.normalized_root_cause: unguarded heredoc redirect into a directory that is never created
entries.notes: PRs 24, 26, and 28 independently proposed guarding the Step 4 desktop-shortcut heredoc against a missing ~/Desktop directory (OSTYPE==linux-gnu* matches headless servers/containers, not just desktops, so the directory frequently does not exist). PR 24 is the prospective canonical executable lineage because it also handles a failed mkdir gracefully instead of assuming it always succeeds; PR 28 additionally carries an independently verified .env quote-stripping fix.
